method: pixel-integrated Gaussian fit on raw cutouts, median per epoch

source.archive: NASA/IPAC IRSA, SPHEREx Level 2 spectral image cutouts

photometry.why: cosmic ray or artifact in the measured pixels (TRANSIENT): 1121 mJy against 22.2 at the nearest wavelengths in all visits and 20.6 for the rest of the visit

photometry_note: sum within 2.5 px, no aperture correction; in 2 of 93 images the pipeline marks a pixel of the aperture as overflowed (the source is near saturation there), so those values may be too low
